movie.title: Suzume
movie.overview: Suzume, 17, lost her mother as a little girl. On her way to school, she meets a mysterious young man. But her curiosity unleashes a calamity that endangers the entire population of Japan, and so Suzume embarks on a journey to set things right.

facts: Did you know 'Suzume' isn't just a standalone film? It's actually the grand finale of Makoto Shinkai's "Disaster trilogy," completing a set that includes beloved hits like 'Your Name' and 'Weathering with You'!

The film's unique central conflict involves Suzume and Souta teaming up to seal special doors, which are the only way to stop a colossal, supernatural worm that's responsible for unleashing devastating earthquakes across Japan.
The entire adventure kicks off because of Suzume herself! Her curiosity accidentally unleashes the very calamity that endangers Japan, making her journey a very personal quest to set things right.
